risks.risk: Controller/accessories not fully shown (seller text implies games installed; photos show one controller on top, but not whether there are 2 controllers, original accessories, power adapter, HDMI, etc.).

risks.risk: Condition/working status beyond dashboard/game splash is unknown (no audio/boot test, no confirmation of disc drive if applicable, no error-free run).

risks.if_unproven: Price as working only for what’s shown (worst case: treat as not fully proven for all claimed games).

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the console model/serial sticker (or “Settings > System > Console info” showing exact Xbox model).
Photo/screenshot of “My games & apps” with the full installed games list visible (showing all 6 titles).

Short video: boot to dashboard, open library, launch FC 26 and one other claimed game (Far Cry 3 / MW3 / Dishonored 2 / Tomb Raider) to prove they run.
response.reason: The photos confirm an Xbox dashboard and FC 26, but they do not clearly prove the exact console model or the full installed-game list/count, which are required to price confidently from the comparables.
